newsitem.title: USA: Capstone commits $22.5 mln for med center.
newsitem.headline: Capstone commits $22.5 mln for med center.

text.p: Capstone Capital Corp said it agreed to commit $22.5 million to develop a comprehensive orthopedic medical center located in Los Angeles.
Construction of the five-story clinic and parking structure is expected to begin in January 1997, with completion in late November 1997.

Ground was broken on Wednesday on the new 90,000-square-foot Kerlan-Jobe Orthopaedic Clinic, which will combine physician offices with an outpatient surgical and diagnostic imaging center, and an outpatient rehabilitation facility.
The facility will be leased on a long-term basis to HealthSouth Rehabilitation Corp Corp and The Kerlan-Jobe Orthopaedic Clinic.
Capstone is a real estate investment trust that currently owns, leases and provides mortgage financing for 56 healthcare related properties located in 13 states.
